subject: Web Development
title: Compression: Gzip and Brotli
description: Learn Compression: Gzip and Brotli in one minute.

hook.text: Text-based files like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript shrink dramatically when compressed.

buildup.text: Gzip has been the default web compression for over two decades. It's fast and reliable.

discovery.text: Brotli, developed by Google, compresses 15-20% better than Gzip for text content.

twist.text: Brotli is slower to compress but faster to decompress. Pre-compressing at build time fixes this.

climax.text: Every modern browser supports Brotli. Free performance is sitting on most servers, unclaimed.

punchline.text: Compression is free speed hiding in plain sight.

quiz.question: How much better does Brotli compress than Gzip?
